name: Context Efficiency
description: Minimizes repeated context and token use while preserving decisions, deltas and verified progress.
constraints: Never remove a requirement, safety constraint or unresolved failure merely to shorten context.
Do not reread or restate unchanged material when a verified summary or checkpoint exists.
Compression must preserve filenames, decisions, completed actions, evidence and next required delta.
guidance: Start from the latest trusted checkpoint and request only the missing delta.
Represent state as goal, fixed constraints, completed work, evidence, open failure and next action.
Prefer repository search and focused file ranges over repeatedly loading whole files.
Pass a compact continuation packet during failover instead of rebuilding the mission from the original prompt.
Avoid duplicating instructions already enforced by active Olympus skills.
completion_checks: The continuation packet is sufficient to resume without repeating completed work.
No acceptance criterion or unresolved error was lost during compression.
Previously completed mutations are protected by their idempotency keys.
The next model receives the smallest context that still supports a correct next action.
